name: Gamm Winter & Spring Intensive Jr. (The Gamm Theatre Camps)
description_short: One-week theatre day programs for students in grades 2–8 during February and April school vacations, led by professional theatre artists. Each week ends with a 35-minute performance on Friday evening.

warnings: Tuition depends on residency: $350 for non-Warwick residents, $250 for Warwick residents. Session prices are recorded at the non-resident rate.
The Spring Intensive dates give no year ("April 19th to Friday, April 23rd"). They were recorded as 2027 because April 19, 2027 falls on a Monday, matching the listed weekday.

Each session has its own registration link. Winter: https://gammtheatre.my.salesforce-sites.com/ticket/#/instances/a0Fcw00000yuJLZEA2. Spring: https://gammtheatre.my.salesforce-sites.com/ticket/#/instances/a0Fcw00000yuJdJEAU.
The page describes summer camps (improv, backstage skills, Shakespeare, workshops of one to four weeks) but lists only February and April vacation intensives. No summer sessions are shown yet.
The page says "Extended Day Friday". This appears to mean the Friday evening performance at 7:00 PM, not an extended-care option.
price_per_week was left empty because the weekly rate depends on residency ($250 or $350).
